subtasks.name: open(microwave)
subtasks.outcome: never attempted: door closed all episode, handle never grasped

behaviour_summary: pi0 went to the plate in front of the microwave instead, hovered over/around it with varied wrist rotations for most of the episode, briefly came near the microwave handle (~360) and ended above the plate; the microwave was never opened.

failures.mode_definition: pi0 wanders or hovers among non-target objects and fixtures for the whole episode and never approaches or grasps the instructed target.
hl_remedy: HALT after 3 frames with the gripper over a non-target object (plate)
REPROMPT 'open the door of the microwave'
WATCH 3 s for the EE to approach the microwave handle
failures.prevention: Coordinator VLM-checks after 2-3 frames that the EE is moving toward the instructed fixture's handle; on mismatch HALT early instead of waiting for timeout.
failures.observation: Step 60 gripper descends between plate and microwave; 80-120 it hovers directly above the plate; 140-340 it wanders around the plate with large wrist rotations, no grasp; 360 briefly near the handle side; 380-409 back above the plate. Microwave door closed throughout.

notes: Contrast with init0 of the same task, where pi0 did go to the handle: target selection is stochastic. The plate does not appear to be grasped or moved significantly.
